modalLead: Category and widget titles keep their size, line up with the bookmarks and stand out from them, and a widget's title heads its card.

items.text: Titles no longer shrink without a reason. A short category name stays at full size when there is room, instead of sitting smaller than the bookmarks under it.
Titles line up with the bookmarks. The // hangs beside the column, the icon sits above the bookmark icons and the name starts where the bookmark names do.
Titles stand out. Bolder and brighter with a short accent mark on the line, over bookmark names in regular weight. A widget's title is now the head of its card.
The Open button on Status page looks like the buttons beside it, without the underline.
